branches.title: Auction yards
branches.description: AUCT yards to read. Pattaya, Chonburi, Rayong, Bangkok and Rangsit by default.

daysAhead.title: Days ahead
daysAhead.description: Auctions from today to this many days ahead.

brands.title: Brands
brands.description: Only these brands, for example Toyota, Honda, Isuzu. Empty for all.

keywords.title: Models
keywords.description: Only cars whose model contains one of these words, for example Fortuner, Yaris, City, D-Max. Empty for all models.

maxMileage.title: Max mileage (km)
maxMileage.description: Skip cars with more kilometres than this.

maxPrice.title: Max price (THB)
maxPrice.description: Skip cars with a higher price than this.

targets.title: My price targets
targets.description: One car per line: words of the model, an optional year and the most you would pay, for example toyota fortuner 2020 750000 or honda city 450000. Cars at or under your price are marked.

minDiscountPercent.title: Only below the reference by (%)
minDiscountPercent.description: Save only cars at least this much below the reference price of the same model and year (cars that match a target are always saved). 0 saves every car that passes the filters.

historyName.title: History store
historyName.description: Named key-value store with the prices of earlier runs, used for the reference price.

delayMs.title: Pause between requests (ms)
delayMs.description: The Actor reads one page at a time with this pause.
